tasks.title: git rebase --autostash main
tasks.description: Rebase the current branch onto main, autostashing any uncommitted changes first.

tasks.title: BUILD pi-web
tasks.description: Build the pi-web sessiond and server

tasks.title: DEV pi-web-sessiond
tasks.description: Start the pi-web session daemon in the current work tree, using state dir /tmp/pi-web (PI_WEB_DATA_DIR). Long-lived, non-autoreload process that owns the session runtime and sessiond.sock.

tasks.title: DEV pi-web-server
tasks.description: Start the pi-web web/API server in the current work tree on port 8192 (PI_WEB_PORT) with state dir /tmp/pi-web (PI_WEB_DATA_DIR). Shares state with the session daemon started by the pi-web-sessiond script.
